strings.name: Lin Dan
strings.summary: Lin rose from youth training in Fujian and an army sports team to China’s national squad. Known for left-handed attack, movement and tactical adjustment, he won consecutive Olympic singles golds in 2008 and 2012 and five world singles titles. His rivalry with Lee Chong Wei widened international interest. After leaving the national team in 2020, he continued promotion and exchanges and entered the BWF Hall of Fame in 2023.
